levels.surface: أبو الحسين محمد بن جعفر الاسدي
محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب

notes: «جماعة من أصحابنا منهم ...»: the text names its members, so the phrase is not an unnamed link (rule 8); the three named men form one level.

Hasan b. Hasan narrates his own conversation with Musa in the first person; Musa is named only in the words after the chain, so he is the last link (owner ruling 2). needs_ruling: whether Hasan is a source or only a narrator within a first-person account is not settled by the text (rule 11).
Ja'far al-Sadiq is quoted inside the story («فإن أبا عبد الله ... قال») and is not made a link.
